description: Verifies a call to a function the surface default catalog does not declare is sent to the agent with its bound arguments resolved, naming the default catalog even though the call names no catalogId, and that its value is null until the agent answers.
name: test_agent_routing_undeclared_function_names_resolved_catalog

description: Verifies a call that names an available catalog other than the surface default, which does not declare the function, is sent to the agent naming that catalog.
name: test_agent_routing_explicit_catalog_id_is_carried

description: Verifies a call to a function the resolved catalog implements runs on the renderer and nothing is sent to the agent.
name: test_agent_routing_implemented_function_runs_locally

description: Verifies an agent call nested in the arguments of a local function is sent first, and the local function runs with the agent's answer once it arrives.
name: test_agent_routing_agent_result_feeds_local_function

description: Verifies an agent error response is reported as an EXPRESSION_ERROR carrying the agent's message, and the value stays null.
name: test_agent_routing_agent_error_is_expression_error

description: Verifies a call naming a catalog the surface does not have is reported as a CATALOG_ERROR and is not sent to the agent.
name: test_agent_routing_unknown_catalog_is_catalog_error

description: Verifies a call that names no catalogId on a surface without a default catalog is reported as a CATALOG_ERROR and is not sent to the agent.
name: test_agent_routing_no_default_catalog_is_catalog_error

description: Verifies a processor without a way to send outbound messages does not route the call, which fails locally with an EXPRESSION_ERROR naming the function.
name: test_agent_routing_without_outbound_listener_fails_locally

description: Verifies a call on a v0.9 surface is never sent to the agent, even when the processor has an outbound listener, and fails locally with an EXPRESSION_ERROR naming the function.
name: test_agent_routing_pre_v1_surface_is_not_routed

description: Verifies a call to an unknown reserved `@` system function is never sent to the agent and fails locally with an EXPRESSION_ERROR.
name: test_agent_routing_system_function_is_not_routed

description: Verifies a second identical call made while the first awaits its response sends no request of its own, and both receive the agent's answer.
name: test_agent_routing_identical_calls_share_one_request

description: Verifies a call that names the surface default catalog and an identical call that relies on it are the same call, so they share one request.
name: test_agent_routing_call_naming_default_catalog_shares_request

description: Verifies calls to the same function with different arguments are separate requests, each answered on its own.
name: test_agent_routing_different_arguments_send_separate_requests

description: Verifies the condition of a check rule is sent to the agent, and the rule passes once the agent answers true.
name: test_agent_routing_check_rule_passes

description: Verifies the condition of a check rule is sent to the agent, and the rule fails once the agent answers false.
name: test_agent_routing_check_rule_fails

description: Verifies the functionCall of an action is sent to the agent when the action runs, and a value response completes it without errors.
name: test_agent_routing_action_function_call

description: Verifies an agent error response to the functionCall of an action is reported as an EXPRESSION_ERROR carrying the agent's message.
name: test_agent_routing_action_agent_error_is_expression_error

description: Verifies a function the resolved catalog declares without an implementation is sent to the agent with its arguments parsed against its schema, so schema defaults (including nested object defaults) are applied.
name: test_agent_routing_schema_only_function_sends_parsed_arguments

description: Verifies a call to a schema-only function whose arguments do not match its schema is reported as an EXPRESSION_ERROR and is not sent to the agent.
name: test_agent_routing_schema_only_function_with_invalid_arguments_is_not_sent

description: Verifies a schema-only function that requires user activation is not sent from a binding, which reports an EXPRESSION_ERROR, but is sent when an action runs it.
name: test_agent_routing_schema_only_function_requires_user_activation

description: Verifies when an agent call nested in the arguments of a local function or an outer agent function fails, only the inner error is reported, the enclosing function does not run or send an outbound call, and its value stays null.
name: test_agent_routing_failed_agent_argument_stops_enclosing_function

description: Verifies when a schema-only function nested in the arguments of a local function or an outer agent function fails argument validation synchronously, only the inner error is reported, the enclosing function does not run or send an outbound call, and its value stays null.
name: test_agent_routing_failed_schema_only_argument_stops_enclosing_function

description: Verifies a settled agent function answer in a reactive binding is cached on the surface, so a later binding with the same call and arguments resolves immediately without sending a second request.
name: test_agent_routing_settled_binding_answer_is_cached_on_surface

description: Verifies reactive bindings whose resolved argument objects have the same keys in different orders share one in-flight request and reuse the settled surface cache entry.
name: test_agent_routing_argument_key_order_is_canonical

description: Verifies imperative action function calls never share an in-flight request and never read from or populate the surface value cache, executing fresh on every action.
name: test_agent_routing_action_calls_never_share_or_cache

description: Verifies a check rule condition routed to the agent handles ValidationResult object responses (valid true/false) and fails closed while reporting EXPRESSION_ERROR when the agent responds with an error.
name: test_agent_routing_check_rule_validation_result_and_error

description: Verifies the context entries of an event action are resolved one after another in declared order, so a later agent call is sent only once the earlier one has answered, and the action is dispatched with every answer once the last call settles.
name: test_agent_routing_event_context_resolves_in_order

description: Verifies that when an agent call in an event action's context fails, the failure is reported once as an EXPRESSION_ERROR, no later context entry is evaluated, so no later call is sent, and the action is not dispatched.
name: test_agent_routing_event_context_stops_at_first_failure

description: Verifies a call whose resolved arguments hold a number with no JSON form (NaN or an infinity) is not sent to the agent and fails locally with an EXPRESSION_ERROR naming the function.
name: test_agent_routing_non_json_argument_fails_locally

description: Verifies deleting the surface cancels its pending agent calls from a binding, a check rule and an action without reporting an error for any of them.
name: test_agent_routing_cancelled_calls_report_no_error

description: Verifies an event action waiting on an agent call when the surface is deleted sends none of its later calls, reports no error, and is not dispatched.
name: test_agent_routing_event_action_after_delete_surface_sends_nothing

description: Verifies a schema-only function whose allowedCallers is agentOnly is refused with an EXPRESSION_ERROR and not sent to the agent, from a binding and from an action.
name: test_agent_routing_agent_only_function_is_refused

description: Verifies a check rule whose condition waits on an agent call does not fail while the call is pending, and fails, reporting an EXPRESSION_ERROR, once the agent answers with an error.
name: test_agent_routing_pending_check_rule_is_not_failing

description: Verifies a binding whose agent call failed does not send it again when an unrelated path the binding reads changes, and sends it again when the call's own arguments change.
name: test_agent_routing_failed_call_is_resent_only_when_its_arguments_change

description: Verifies an event action whose userMessage resolves to a value that is neither a string nor null, synchronously from a binding or asynchronously from an agent call, reports an INVALID_ACTION and is not dispatched.
name: test_agent_routing_event_user_message_must_be_a_string

description: Verifies an event action whose userMessage resolves to null, from a binding to a missing path or from an agent's null answer, is dispatched without a userMessage and reports no error.
name: test_agent_routing_event_null_user_message_is_absent

description: Verifies an agent call cancelled while the surface stays live reports no error and is not remembered as a failure, so the binding sends it again when the object its argument is bound to is replaced by an equal one, and takes the answer. A core whose data model does not notify subscribers of an equal value runs test_agent_routing_cancelled_call_is_sent_again_on_unrelated_change instead.
name: test_agent_routing_cancelled_call_is_sent_again_when_its_value_is_rewritten

description: Verifies an agent call cancelled while the surface stays live reports no error and is not remembered as a failure, so the binding sends it again when an unrelated path the binding reads changes, unlike a call the agent failed. A core that re-evaluates a nested call only when its own arguments change runs test_agent_routing_cancelled_call_is_sent_again_when_its_value_is_rewritten instead.
name: test_agent_routing_cancelled_call_is_sent_again_on_unrelated_change

description: Verifies a formatString template part that calls a function the catalog does not implement is reported as an EXPRESSION_ERROR naming the function and renders empty without sending anything, also when the surface already holds an answer for that exact call.
name: test_agent_routing_template_part_never_routes

description: Verifies a formatString template call inherits formatString's explicit catalogId and fails with EXPRESSION_ERROR when missing from that catalog, rather than falling back to the surface default catalog even when the default catalog implements the function locally.
name: test_agent_routing_template_part_does_not_fall_back_to_default_catalog

description: Verifies agent calls in sibling arguments of one function are all sent, in any order, before any is answered, and that when one fails the enclosing call is not sent, the failure is reported once, and the other sibling's later answer changes nothing.
name: test_agent_routing_sibling_agent_arguments_are_sent_together

description: Verifies a local call refused before it runs, because its arguments fail the function's schema, is reported as an EXPRESSION_ERROR in an action, and in an event action's context, which is then not dispatched.
name: test_agent_routing_refused_call_in_action_is_expression_error

description: Verifies a malformed event action context value is reported as an EXPRESSION_ERROR naming the entry and the action is not dispatched, whether the entry is the first or follows an entry that waits on the agent.
name: test_agent_routing_malformed_event_context_value
